links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified online patient education materials
links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of peripheral nerve surgery patient education materials
links.effect: Mean FKGL fell from 11.3 (original) to 7.5 with ChatGPT rewrites and to 5.6 with Gemini rewrites (both p < 0.001)
links.tradeoff: Gemini rewrites had lower accuracy/quality (4.0/5.0 vs 4.5/5.0 for ChatGPT) and lower comprehensiveness (1.0/3.0 vs 2.0/3.0), both p < 0.001. The simpler Gemini text lost some content.
links.quote: The average FKGL of ChatGPT rewrites was significantly lower than that of OPEMs (11.3 vs. 7.5, p < 0.001), as was the average FKGL of Gemini rewrites (11.3 vs. 5.6, p < 0.001).
